sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 47 (#46) and Internal Quality Checks row 47 (#46; no extra annotation columns populated)
task/tests/Dockerfile, task/tests/.dockerignore, task/tests/test.sh, task/task.toml, task/tests/**/prompt.md (n-gram overlap scan)
evidence: Agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile, byte-identical to the frozen template) only COPYs instructions/ and assets/ and installs express+better-sqlite3; no rubric, judge client or RewardKit. Built the frozen environment/ context locally (docker build, tag qc46-agent-probe:tmp, removed afterwards) and listed it: / has app (.git,.gitkeep), assets/seed_data.json, instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md; /tests and /solution absent; pip3 absent; npm -g = better-sqlite3, corepack, express, npm; find for prompt.md/judge.toml/scoring.toml/score.py/rewardkit*/app_context.md returned nothing. Public files contain no criterion/rubric/judge/reward wording; 10-gram overlap between public docs and every tests/*/prompt.md is 0 (only the account roster overlaps app_context.md, which is public seed data). Grading is isolated: task.toml [verifier] environment_mode = "separate"; tests/Dockerfile (template-identical) installs harbor-rewardkit/claude-code only in the verifier and does COPY . /tests + chmod -R go-rwx /tests. Influence on reward: test.sh (template-identical) writes zero reward first (line 60), rejects symlinks outside /app/node_modules (72-83), runs the submission as uid 65534 via setpriv with env -i (104-111) while /tests and LOG_DIR (umask 077, chmod 700, lines 3,11-12) are root-only, so the app cannot read criteria or write reward.json/reward.txt; score.py computes reward from rewardkit output. Broken-app probe: an app that writes /logs/verifier/reward.json or reads /tests/scored/*/prompt.md fails on permissions (non-root uid); a conforming app is unaffected. Residual UI-text prompt injection toward the judge belongs to row 45, not this row. No full configured verifier run on these bytes exists, but this row is structural and does not depend on one.
